DAT.Common.GMOnly: Only a game master can do that.
DAT.Dash.Title: Level Manager
DAT.Dash.NotOpen: This scene is not open, so you can't see it on the map yet.
DAT.Dash.OpenFailed: The scene could not be opened ({error}).
DAT.Dash.NoScene: No scene is open. Import a Dungeon Alchemist export to make one, or open a scene that has floors.
DAT.Dash.NoLevels: "{name}" has no floors yet. Import a Dungeon Alchemist export to make a scene with floors.
DAT.Dash.NotJoined: Some floors can't be reached from the start floor yet.
DAT.Dash.MoreStairs: {count} more stairs are not drawn here. They are all on the Stairs tab.
DAT.Dash.NoStairs: No stairs on this floor yet.
DAT.Dash.ReplaceImageHint: Swap this floor's map image. Its stairs, tokens and lights stay.
DAT.Dash.SetStartHint: The floor players see first when the scene opens
DAT.Dash.AddFloorHint: Add a new floor from a picture or video file
DAT.Dash.OpenNativeHint: What each floor shows of the others is set in Foundry's own Levels tab
DAT.Dash.AllStairsHd: Stairs, teleports and traps in this scene
DAT.Dash.AdoptStair: Turn this into a stair the Level Manager can edit
DAT.Dash.NoStairsAll: No stairs, teleports or traps in this scene yet.
DAT.Dash.BadElevation: A floor's bottom has to be lower than its top, so the height was left as it was.
DAT.Dash.NoPicker: Foundry's file picker isn't available here.
DAT.Dash.RemoveConfirm: Remove "{name}" from this scene? Its map image goes. Tokens, lights, walls and stairs you placed on it stay in the scene, so clear those up on the map or in Foundry's Levels tab.
DAT.Dash.UpdateFailed: The floor change was not saved ({error}).
DAT.Dash.UpdateDrift: The floors did not save as expected. Check them in Foundry's Levels tab.
DAT.Dash.LastFloor: A scene keeps at least one floor, so the last one can't be removed.
DAT.Todo.Title: Left to do
DAT.Entry.RetiredNote: The Stairs Manager and the old region tool are now part of the Level Manager, on its Stairs tab. Stairs made with the old tool are listed there with an Adopt button.
DAT.Settings.ToolbarButton.Name: Toolbar button
DAT.Settings.ToolbarButton.Hint: Adds a Dungeon Alchemist button to the scene toolbar that opens the Level Manager. Turn it off if it ever gets in the way. The Level Manager still opens from Module Settings and from each scene's right-click menu.
DAT.Settings.DropImport.Name: Import by dropping a folder
DAT.Settings.DropImport.Hint: Drag the folder Dungeon Alchemist exported from your desktop onto the Foundry window to import it. Turn it off if it ever gets in the way of dropping other files.
DAT.Hub.Title: Dungeon Alchemist Toolkit
DAT.Hub.MenuHint: Floors and stairs for the scene you have open, and the import.
DAT.Importer.Title: Import from Dungeon Alchemist
DAT.Importer.GMOnly: Only a game master can import scenes.
DAT.Importer.NoBrowse: Foundry's file browser isn't available here.
DAT.Importer.BrowseFailed: The folder "{path}" could not be opened ({error}).
DAT.Importer.NoneHere: No Dungeon Alchemist floors in this folder yet. A floor is a picture or video with a .json file of the same name.
DAT.Importer.SizeBig: {name} · {mb} MB. A file this big makes the scene slow to open.
DAT.Importer.OrphanList: {count} files left out because they have no partner: {names}
DAT.Importer.ColOrder: Order, top floor first. Drag a number to change it, or use the arrow keys.
DAT.Importer.DragHint: Drag to change the order, or use the up and down arrow keys
DAT.Importer.MoveAria: Move {name}. Use the up and down arrow keys.
DAT.Importer.RoofDetected: {count} files have "roof" in their name and are marked as roofs: {names}. Tick Advanced to change that.
DAT.Importer.SysPickHint: Pick the folder with Foundry's own file picker
DAT.Importer.BrowseHint: Open the folder Dungeon Alchemist exported. Its floors are found as you browse. You can also drag that folder from your desktop onto the Foundry window.
DAT.Importer.FloorsTitle: Floors · which one is at street level?
DAT.Importer.HeightHint: How tall every floor is. Tick Advanced to set one floor on its own.
DAT.Importer.AdvHelpIntro: Most maps need none of these.
DAT.Importer.AdvHelpRange: Bottom and Top set one floor's height by hand. Street level starts at 0, and floors below it go below zero.
DAT.Importer.AdvHelpRoof: Roof is only for a picture that is the roof of the floor below it. It shows while you are on that lower floor and takes its height from it. If you are not sure you have one, leave it off.
DAT.Importer.AdvHelpStart: Start is the floor players see first when the scene opens. It follows street level until you pick another.
DAT.Importer.StreetTip: Pick the floor at street level. Floors below it become Basement 1, 2 and go below zero. Floors above count up from the ground. A file with "roof" in its name is called Roof.
DAT.Importer.GridOpacityHint: 0 hides the grid, 1 shows it fully.
DAT.Importer.CopyMedia: Copy the files into this world
DAT.Importer.CopyMediaHint: Copies each floor's picture or video into worlds/<world>/da-imported/<map-name>/ and points the scene at the copies.
DAT.Importer.DoorTextureHint: Drawn on every door, with a swing when it opens. None leaves doors plain.
DAT.Importer.DoorSoundHint: Played when an imported door opens or closes. None uses Foundry's own.
DAT.Importer.NoFolder: Open a folder that holds a Dungeon Alchemist export first.
DAT.Importer.NoPairs: No Dungeon Alchemist floors in that folder. A floor is a picture or video with a .json file of the same name.
DAT.Importer.Orphans: {count} files were left out because they have no partner: a picture or video with no .json, or the other way round. The console lists them.
DAT.Importer.MixedMaps: This folder holds {count} different maps ({maps}). They will all go into one scene. Put each map in its own folder if that is not what you want.
DAT.Importer.JsonFailed: The floor data could not be read ({error}).
DAT.Importer.AllFloorsFailed: none of the .json files could be read
DAT.Importer.FloorsDropped: {count} floors were left out because their .json could not be read. The rest are imported, and the console lists the ones left out.
DAT.Importer.FolderFailed: The folder for the copies could not be made ({error}).
DAT.Importer.CopyFailed: "{name}" could not be copied ({error}), so that floor uses the file where it is.
DAT.Importer.BadDimensions: No floor has a usable map size. Width, height and grid must be above zero (got width {width}, height {height}, grid {grid}).
DAT.Importer.SceneCreateFailed: The scene could not be made ({error}).
DAT.Importer.SceneCreateEmpty: Foundry made no scene. The console says why.
DAT.Importer.Created: Made "{name}" with {levels} floors, {walls} walls and {lights} lights.
DAT.Importer.Oversize: {count} files are over about 50 MB ({names}). Big videos make a scene slow to open.
DAT.Importer.BadElevation: These floors have a bottom that is not below their top: {levels}. Fix the heights, then import.
DAT.Drop.Here: Drop the Dungeon Alchemist export folder here
DAT.Drop.NoFloors: No Dungeon Alchemist floors in what you dropped. A floor is a picture or video with a .json file of the same name.
DAT.Drop.NoUpload: This Foundry can't take dropped files. Put the folder in Foundry's files and browse to it instead.
DAT.Drop.Copying: Copying {count} files into this world, about {mb} MB
DAT.Drop.Failed: The dropped folder could not be imported ({error}).
DAT.Stairs.KindLong.stairs: Stairs, shown to players, who choose to use them
DAT.Stairs.KindLong.teleport: Teleport, shown to players, who choose to use it
DAT.Stairs.KindLong.trap: Trap, hidden, moves the token with no warning
DAT.Stairs.FieldStops: Names for each end, shown to players
DAT.Stairs.NewHint: Next you place each end on the map, one floor at a time. Both ends can be on the same floor.
DAT.Stairs.DeleteOld: Delete this area made with the old tool?
DAT.Stairs.DeleteAll: Delete this stair and every one of its ends?
DAT.Stairs.StepMore: "{label}": place end {step}, or press Done ({count} placed)
DAT.Stairs.StepHint: Pick the floor, then click or drag on the map. Esc cancels.
DAT.Stairs.WellHint: The stair goes at this same spot on every ticked floor. Leave a floor unticked to skip it. If an end belongs somewhere else, place each end yourself. Any end can be dragged afterwards.
DAT.Stairs.WellDrag: Drag where the stairs are on {floor}
DAT.Stairs.WellDragHint: Click for one square, or drag for a bigger area. Esc cancels.
DAT.Stairs.WellNeedTwo: A stairwell needs two floors or more. Tick another floor, or choose "Place each end myself".
DAT.Stairs.NoLevels: This scene has no floors yet. Import a map or add floors first.
DAT.Stairs.InProgress: You are already placing stairs. Finish or cancel that first.
DAT.Stairs.PlacementFailed: The stairs could not be placed ({error}).
DAT.Stairs.CreatedTeleport: Teleport made on one floor, with {count} ends.
DAT.Stairs.CreateFailed: The stairs could not be made ({error}).
DAT.Stairs.LinkSelectTwo: Select exactly two areas on the Regions layer first (click one, Shift-click the other), then run this again.
DAT.Stairs.AlreadyPortal: One of those areas is already part of a stair. Delete that stair in the Level Manager first.
DAT.Stairs.Linked: The two areas are now joined.
DAT.Stairs.LinkFailed: The areas could not be joined ({error}).
DAT.Stairs.Adopted: The Level Manager can now edit this stair.
DAT.Stairs.AdoptFailed: The stair could not be adopted ({error}).
DAT.Stairs.DeleteFailed: The stairs could not be deleted ({error}).
DAT.Stairs.UseHint: Walk your token onto the stairs to use them.
DAT.Stairs.WalkNoPath: There is no clear way to those stairs from here.
DAT.Stairs.WalkStopped: Your token was stopped on the way.
